pros.claim: Stopping the payment authorisation reliably removes the complaint class that does the most reputational damage
pros.example: a recurring charge continuing after a confirmed cancellation because only the service record had been closed

cons.claim: A frictionless exit ends accounts that an honest conversation might legitimately have kept
cons.example: a family who cancelled over a fixable device fault they had never mentioned to anyone

cons.claim: Immediate effect and refunds cost revenue that a term contract would have protected
cons.example: a mid-period cancellation refunded under the operator's own stated rule rather than held to a term

failure_modes: closing the service record without cancelling the recurring payment authorisation
routing the wearer's own cancellation to the paying relative for approval
requiring equipment return before the cancellation takes effect
acceptance_tests: the cancellation path is documented channel by channel and passes the symmetry test against the current sign-up path
a sampled cancellation shows the payment authorisation stopped, the confirmation sent and the return method provided
revisit_triggers: the jurisdiction's renewal or cancellation-channel obligation class changes
a complaint reports billing after a confirmed cancellation
a new sign-up channel is added, which moves the symmetry baseline

nodes.definition: Read the health of the recurring book as a mechanism the operator fills with their own figures, never as a number borrowed from the industry. Four quantities move recurring margin and each is derivable from documents the operator already holds. What a live account contributes each month: the subscription actually billed, less the wholesale per-account fee on the monitoring invoice, less payment processing and billing cost, less the amortised service cost that account generated in visits, parts and calls. How long accounts last: the tenure distribution of closed accounts read from the account records, which in this business is shaped far more by the wearer's life stage than by satisfaction, and therefore must always be read beside the cancellation-reason mix rather than treated as a satisfaction score. What it costs to keep an account alive: the service load per account, which the health review already measures. And what replaces losses: additions per period, whose cost belongs to the acquisition work rather than here. The discipline that makes this honest is that every term traces to an invoice, a contract clause or a dated record, and that no resulting ratio is compared against an outside benchmark the operator cannot verify.

included: the four-part mechanism with the internal document each term traces to
reading tenure beside the cancellation-reason mix rather than alone
the prohibition on comparing derived ratios to unverifiable outside benchmarks
excluded: any specific price, wholesale rate, margin, tenure or churn figure stated as fact
acquisition cost and channel allocation, which belong to the acquisition knowledge base
accounting, tax or financing advice

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a renegotiated monitoring contract, a shift in the reason mix, or a measured change in service load per account

pros.claim: A traced mechanism shows which lever is actually available in a given period rather than which one is fashionable
pros.example: seeing that service load per account, not price, is what moved contribution after a fleet fault

pros.claim: Reading tenure beside the reason mix prevents mistaking a demographic ending for a service failure
pros.example: a period of shorter tenure explained by a cluster of moves into residential care rather than by dissatisfaction

cons.claim: The mechanism yields nothing until the operator separates figures many small businesses keep merged
cons.example: an owner whose monitoring invoice is never reconciled per account and who cannot say what one account contributes

cons.claim: Per-account contribution can flatter a business that still cannot carry its fixed base
cons.example: a healthy contribution per account alongside a vehicle, insurance and telephone base the account count cannot yet cover

failure_modes: quoting an industry churn or margin figure instead of computing from the operator's own records
reading tenure as a satisfaction score in a business where the wearer's life stage dominates it
leaving service cost out so accounts appear more profitable than they are
acceptance_tests: every term in the mechanism names the internal document it traces to, with no external figure asserted anywhere
tenure is presented alongside the cancellation-reason mix rather than on its own
revisit_triggers: the monitoring contract, equipment cost or payment-processing cost changes
the cancellation-reason mix shifts materially
service load per account moves after a fleet or process change

nodes.definition: Convert well-served accounts into new ones without ever making a family feel harvested. The referrals genuinely available to this business come from three places the service itself creates: families who watched the arrangement work during a real event, families whose experience of leaving was clean and kind, and the professionals around the wearer — an aide, a building manager, a residence administrator — who observed the business behave well over time. The rules that keep this honest are about timing and consent rather than about wording. The moments to ask are moments of demonstrated competence: a completed visit the household is visibly happy with, a service issue closed properly, or an unprompted expression of thanks. The moments never to ask are during or shortly after an incident, at any point in a bereavement, and during any cancellation, because gratitude and grief are not the same thing and a business that cannot tell them apart will eventually make the mistake everybody hears about. Nothing about a wearer appears in a testimonial without their own recorded permission, and nothing health-related appears at all. Any compensation arrangement with a professional referrer sits inside the referral-inducement boundary governing this business's acquisition work and is verified against current rules in the operator's jurisdiction.

included: the three service-created referral sources
the permitted moments and the absolutely prohibited moments, with automatic suppression rules
testimonial consent recorded from the wearer, with health detail excluded entirely
excluded: pre-sale referral-channel building with discharge planners, home-care agencies and senior centres and the compensation rules governing them, which belong to the acquisition knowledge base
advertising claims and competitive positioning
any use of an account's health-adjacent details in marketing material

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a complaint about a referral approach, or a change in the acquisition side's referral-compensation arrangements

pros.claim: A referral earned after demonstrated reliability arrives pre-qualified and costs almost nothing against cold acquisition
pros.example: a neighbour who watched the response during a real event enquiring without any advertising spend behind it

pros.claim: Explicit forbidden moments protect the business from the one mistake that undoes a good reputation quickly
pros.example: a suppression rule that blocks any referral approach to a household for a defined period after a bereavement closure

cons.claim: Even a well-timed ask can make a service relationship feel transactional to a family
cons.example: a daughter who wanted only to say thank you being handed a request for other names

cons.claim: Service-created referrals arrive on their own schedule and cannot be turned up when the book needs additions
cons.example: a quiet period in which honest referral flow simply does not replace the losses

failure_modes: asking during or immediately after an incident because gratitude feels highest at that moment
publishing a testimonial that reveals the wearer's condition, address or building
letting a professional referral arrangement drift outside the inducement boundary that governs acquisition
acceptance_tests: the referral policy names the permitted and prohibited moments, and bereavement closures are suppressed automatically rather than by memory
every published testimonial carries the wearer's own recorded permission and contains no health detail
revisit_triggers: a referral approach draws a complaint
the acquisition side changes its referral-compensation arrangements
a bereavement or open-incident household is found to have received an approach

edges.why_related: the record exists to hold exactly the facts the promised signal chain needs in order to work, so the promise decides which fields are mandatory
the charter's conduct limits establish that the wearer is the customer, which is the premise the disclosure and authority lists are built on
the autonomy rules are the operational expression of the charter's conduct limits during the live subscription
the test programme needs the record's equipment inventory, transport and contact details to know what it is testing and whom to call
supervisory events are meaningless until they can be attached to a specific unit, transport and account in the record
the currency routine maintains fields the record defines and dates, and writes confirmations back into it
no proactive family contact can be designed before it is known who may be told what about the wearer
the register and content rules for family updates are drawn from the autonomy rules about how the wearer is spoken of
the low-battery and docking events the platform actually delivers are the primary triggers the replacement routine fires on
non-wear is inferred largely from docking, movement and activity indications the health feed supplies
the last test result is a mandatory component of the composed account health state
confirmation dates on the address and the contact tree are components of the health state, which is why a working device alone cannot make an account healthy
the accumulated test record is the baseline the investigation reasons against when deciding whether a path was ever proven from that room
nothing may be disclosed or remedied until the reconstruction has separated what is established from what cannot be determined
the health history of an account is what allows a stated ending reason to be checked against what the business already knew
the move-to-higher-care class is what routes an ending into the redundancy and suspension conversation
the bereavement class is what triggers the dignified-stop path and suppresses every commercial process
every ending, whatever its cause, is executed through the same mechanical exit path and records its class there
tenure can only be computed from closures that were executed and dated consistently through the exit path
registration and supervision behaviour per transport is what makes an approaching retirement visible before it strands units
the charter bounds what a remedy may promise, so recovery cannot buy back trust with a guarantee the service never offered
who may be named, quoted or approached is bounded by the wearer's own recorded permissions rather than by the family's willingness
the autonomy rules cap what may be done with a non-wear observation, forbidding both disclosure outside permissions and use as leverage over the wearer
the charter's refusal to coordinate care is the boundary staff read aloud to aides, building desks and residence staff
protecting recurring revenue creates constant pressure to add a step, a channel restriction or a delay to the exit path
edges.resolution_rule: the frictionless exit wins without exception; recurring revenue may be defended only by longer account life earned through service quality and honest fit, never by exit friction, and any proposed change to the cancellation path must first pass the symmetry test

edges.why_related: the family that pays wants visibility into events and behaviour that the wearer may have chosen not to share
edges.resolution_rule: the wearer's recorded disclosure permissions govern; where they restrict, the business tells the family plainly that a limit exists and who set it, rather than implying nothing happened, and invites the family to ask the wearer directly

edges.why_related: the cheapest cure for nuisance activations is to make the equipment less likely to fire, which silently narrows the coverage the charter promised
edges.resolution_rule: coverage wins by default: physical and procedural remedies must be exhausted and recorded first, and any reduction in detection sensitivity requires the family's informed decision with the trade written out and the charter's promise restated as it now stands

edges.why_related: the households most grateful for the service are often the ones that have just lost the wearer, which makes them the most tempting and the most forbidden to ask
edges.resolution_rule: bereavement suppression wins absolutely and automatically; a household closed under the bereavement class is removed from every referral and marketing list at closure and no approach may be re-enabled by anyone's judgement that this family would not mind

edges.why_related: the interval that proves the chain still works is also a repeated intrusion into the day of someone who did not want a monitored life
edges.resolution_rule: the interval required by the supervision window is kept, but its form is negotiated with the wearer — operator-initiated rather than wearer-initiated, a preferred time of day, or folded into a single combined contact — and it is never quietly dropped to avoid annoying the household

edges.why_related: an unworn device eventually becomes a cancellation, so persistent non-wear is an early and readable cause of an ending rather than a separate problem
families told something true after a failure become the strongest advocates the business has, which is why recovery quality feeds referral flow
ageing cells, failing cradles and worn contacts generate spurious and supervisory events that present to staff as nuisance activity
the redundancy conversation and the suspension decision come first, and only then is the mechanical exit executed and dated
the billing stop and marketing suppression happen on notification, and the formal closure and equipment return follow through the exit path
what an activation reveals about the path, the equipment and the rooms actually used feeds back into where and how often tests are run
service load and reason-mix patterns read at book level re-aim the review's triage rules at the drivers that actually cost the business
root causes that turn out to be dead numbers or wrong access details tighten the confirmation routine that should have caught them
both are post-event routines that reconstruct what the chain actually did and both depend on retrieving the monitoring centre's record inside its retention window

conflict_axes.name: wearer_privacy_versus_family_visibility
conflict_axes.description: The relative who pays and worries wants to know what happened and whether the device is being worn; the wearer may have chosen to share very little, and both positions are legitimate.
poles: report freely to the family who pays and worries
disclose only what the wearer has authorised
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the wearer's recorded permissions govern, and where they restrict, the family is told plainly that a limit exists and who set it rather than being left to infer that nothing happened

conflict_axes.name: recurring_revenue_versus_frictionless_exit
conflict_axes.description: Every recurring-revenue instinct pushes toward making the exit slower, narrower or conditional, while the business's whole claim to trust with a vulnerable population rests on leaving being as easy as joining.
poles: protect the recurring book at the exit
make leaving no harder than joining
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: defend revenue only through account longevity earned by service quality and honest fit; run the symmetry test against the sign-up path before any change to the cancellation route is accepted

conflict_axes.name: detection_sensitivity_versus_nuisance_burden
conflict_axes.description: Reducing nuisance activations is genuinely valuable to responders, families and the wearer, but the cheapest lever quietly removes the coverage the family is paying for.
poles: preserve every path by which help can be summoned
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: work the remedy ladder from placement and form factor through briefing and training, and treat any sensitivity reduction as the family's recorded decision with the consequence written out

conflict_axes.name: test_rigour_versus_intrusion_into_a_life
conflict_axes.description: Proving the chain requires repeated contact with someone who often experienced the whole arrangement as an imposition in the first place.
poles: test and confirm as often as the risk warrants
leave the household alone between real events
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep the interval the supervision window requires but negotiate its form and timing with the wearer, and combine test, address and contact confirmation into a single contact

conflict_axes.name: candid_disclosure_versus_liability_caution
conflict_axes.description: After a failure the most trust-restoring act and the most legally exposing act are frequently the same sentence.
poles: tell the family everything the reconstruction established
say only what cannot be used against the business
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclose established facts and named uncertainty in plain language while leaving liability characterisation to counsel, and never let caution become a refusal to say what happened

conflict_axes.name: fleet_standardisation_versus_continuity_for_the_wearer
conflict_axes.description: A single supported device generation is far cheaper and safer to maintain, but every migration takes a familiar object away from an older adult who had finally stopped thinking about it.
poles: standardise the fleet on supported equipment
leave a working familiar device alone
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: migrate only where support, transport or observed reliability requires it, sequence by exposure, and treat the swap as a fresh installation with training and an end-to-end test rather than a parts exchange

conflict_axes.name: service_cost_discipline_versus_promised_reliability
conflict_axes.description: Visits, parts and confirmation calls are the largest controllable cost in a recurring book and also the entire substance of the reliability the business sells.
poles: prove the chain and refresh the record as often as risk requires
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cut cost by consolidating contacts and by triaging on exposure, never by lengthening the test interval past the supervision window or by deferring confirmation of contacts and access

conflict_axes.name: referral_growth_versus_restraint_at_hard_moments
conflict_axes.description: The moments of greatest gratitude in this business are adjacent to the moments of greatest grief, and an operator who cannot tell them apart will eventually ask at exactly the wrong time.
poles: ask when the service has just proved itself
never trade on an emergency or a death
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: ask only at moments of demonstrated competence such as a completed visit or a resolved issue, and enforce automatic suppression for bereavement closures and open incidents rather than relying on individual judgement

conflict_axes.name: wearer_autonomy_versus_pressure_to_act_on_risk
conflict_axes.description: When the business observes something worrying — a device never worn, a household that has changed — the family and its own staff feel a duty to act that the wearer has not granted anyone.
poles: act on what the service observes
respect the wearer's own decisions about her life
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state observations plainly to those the wearer authorised, offer the practical remedies the business actually controls, and stop there; never use a service observation to argue about where or how the wearer should live

edge_cases.description: The wearer died some weeks ago and the family, occupied with everything else, never told the business; the subscription has continued to bill a bank account nobody is watching
edge_cases.trigger: an account continues to bill with no test response, no supervisory activity and no contact from the household
edge_cases.mitigation: treat prolonged silence across test, supervisory and contact channels as a health-review trigger for a gentle welfare enquiry to the listed contacts, stop billing from the date of notification and refund the intervening period on the operator's stated rule without requiring documents

edge_cases.description: An emergency contact's number was disconnected months ago and the fact is discovered by the monitoring centre during a real activation rather than by the business during a confirmation
edge_cases.trigger: the contact tree is worked during an alarm and the first listed contact rings nowhere
edge_cases.mitigation: rebuild the tree in aftercare with dialled verification of every entry, record the failure as a currency-routine defect rather than as bad luck, and shorten the confirmation interval for accounts whose trees have shown decay

edge_cases.description: The wearer has moved in with a daughter in another town for the winter and the device travelled with her, while the account still shows the original address and entry code
edge_cases.trigger: a household relocation that nobody reported because the family did not think of the alarm as something that needed telling
edge_cases.mitigation: use the periodic contact to ask where the wearer is actually sleeping rather than to read the stored address back, and treat any move as a fresh assessment of transport, range and access details written to both copies of the record

edge_cases.description: Repeated activations arrive every morning at the same time, produced by the aide's handling during a transfer rather than by any need for help
edge_cases.trigger: a recurring nuisance-activation pattern that correlates with a care routine
edge_cases.mitigation: brief the aide and the agency on unclipping and reattaching, adjust cord length or form factor first, and only consider a sensitivity change after the physical and procedural remedies are recorded as tried

edge_cases.description: The adult child who pays demands regular reports on whether his mother is wearing the pendant, and she has explicitly declined to authorise that disclosure
edge_cases.trigger: a payer request for behavioural information the wearer's disclosure permissions exclude
edge_cases.mitigation: decline the report, tell the payer plainly that a limit exists and that his mother set it, offer to ask her whether she wishes to change it, and record both the request and the refusal on the account

edge_cases.description: A press produced no response because the base unit had been unplugged during redecoration and the mains-loss event sat unread in the platform feed
edge_cases.trigger: a failed activation traced to an unpowered base unit with an unactioned supervisory event in the history
edge_cases.mitigation: disclose the unread event as the business's own fault, attach an obligation and a response time to every mains-loss and unit-missing event class, and verify that the feed is worked on a schedule rather than on curiosity

edge_cases.description: A carrier announces the retirement of the cellular generation that a portion of the mobile units depend on, mid-subscription and with families already paying
edge_cases.trigger: a transport retirement announcement affecting live accounts
edge_cases.mitigation: list every affected account from the transport field, sequence by exposure with the most isolated wearers first, state the cost position once and apply it to everyone, and run an end-to-end test on each swapped unit before closing the visit

edge_cases.description: The wearer is admitted to hospital for an extended stay and the family asks whether they should keep paying while the flat is empty
edge_cases.trigger: an extended absence with an uncertain return
edge_cases.mitigation: offer suspension only where a return home is genuinely possible, attach an end date and a named owner to it, and otherwise cancel cleanly rather than letting a paying account protect an empty flat

edge_cases.description: A cancellation request arrives from a relative who is not on the authority list and who says the wearer agrees but cannot come to the telephone
edge_cases.trigger: an instruction to end the service from someone with no recorded authority
edge_cases.mitigation: stop any further billing immediately as a protective act while confirming the instruction with the wearer or a listed authority, and never use the authority gap as a reason to keep charging

edge_cases.description: The monitoring centre's record of an incident contradicts the family's account of what was said and when
edge_cases.trigger: an irreconcilable difference between the centre's record and the household's recollection
edge_cases.mitigation: present both accounts as what each source says rather than adjudicating between them, state plainly which parts cannot be determined, escalate to the monitoring partner under the reporting obligation class, and remedy what is established regardless of the dispute

edge_cases.description: A grateful family offers a public testimonial that describes the wearer's fall, her diagnosis and the building she lives in
edge_cases.trigger: an offered testimonial containing health and location detail about a living wearer
edge_cases.mitigation: accept only with the wearer's own recorded permission, strip all health detail and any locating information, and decline entirely rather than publish something the wearer might regret when neighbours read it

edge_cases.description: The household changes its telephone or internet service and an in-home unit's signalling path stops working without anyone noticing until the next test
edge_cases.trigger: a change of home telephone or broadband service under a unit that depends on it
edge_cases.mitigation: warn every household with a service-dependent unit that changing provider affects the alarm, treat any reported change as an immediate test trigger, and prefer transports whose loss the platform reports rather than transports that fail silently

workflow.action: Write the live-service promise and the refusal boundary
workflow.description: Fix the signal chain the subscription buys, the clinical and outcome refusals, and the conduct limits that bind the business for the whole account life
workflow.artifact: one-page service promise and refusal statement issued to every customer
workflow.gate: the signal chain, the enumerated refusals and the conduct limits are stated in language a customer can read without help

workflow.action: Stand up the account record of truth and reconcile it with the monitoring centre
workflow.description: Define the field set including access details, equipment serials and transport, and establish the reconciliation cadence against the centre's copy
workflow.artifact: per-account live record with per-field confirmation dates and a reconciliation log
workflow.gate: every responder-relevant field carries a last-confirmed date and a sampled account matches the monitoring centre's copy

workflow.action: Record disclosure permissions and account authority from the wearer
workflow.description: Capture separately who may be told what and who may change or end the service, plus any legal-authority instrument by type and verification date
workflow.artifact: per-account disclosure list and authority list dated to the wearer's own statement
workflow.gate: both lists exist for every live account and no account treats the payer as an authority by default

workflow.action: Design and publish the periodic test programme
workflow.description: Set the interval inside the platform supervision window, choose the initiation model, define the pass criteria and attach an escalation clock to a miss
workflow.artifact: written test programme plus a per-account test log with locations and outcomes
workflow.gate: the interval is justified against the supervision window and every logged miss shows an escalation outcome

workflow.action: Register the supervisory events the platform actually delivers
workflow.description: Confirm against the monitoring contract which events arrive and in what form, and attach an obligation and a response time to each class
workflow.artifact: supervisory event register with per-event obligations, confirmed against the contract
workflow.gate: no event class in the register is assumed; each is traceable to the contract or to a platform confirmation

workflow.action: Establish the address and contact currency routine
workflow.description: Fold scheduled confirmation into the test contact, define the event-driven triggers, and require dialled verification with a dual write to both record copies
workflow.artifact: confirmation schedule and dated contact-tree records in both systems
workflow.gate: a sampled account shows dialled verification and the same values in the local record and the centre's copy

workflow.action: Compose per-account health states and open the triage queue
workflow.description: Combine test, supervisory, consumable, currency and wear components into one dated state and order the unhealthy accounts by exposure
workflow.artifact: dated account health states and an exposure-ordered work queue with owners
workflow.gate: every live account has a dated state and every unhealthy account has an owner, a due date and a recorded outcome

workflow.action: Define the caregiver communication protocol under the autonomy rules
workflow.description: Fix which events trigger proactive contact, to which audience, through which channel and in what timeframe, bounded by the disclosure permissions
workflow.artifact: proactive contact matrix by event, audience, channel and timeframe
workflow.gate: each qualifying event has an audience, a channel and a timeframe, and no template carries an offer

workflow.action: Brief the people around the wearer and record professional consents
workflow.description: Give aides, building desks and residence staff the narrow mechanical briefing and the boundary statement, and confirm consent for any professional on the contact tree
workflow.artifact: briefing sheet per interface type and recorded consents for professional contacts
workflow.gate: every professional listed on a contact tree has a recorded consent and every briefing carries the non-coordination boundary

workflow.action: Install the incident path from aftercare through reconstruction to disclosure
workflow.description: Write the runbook that restores an account after any activation and reconstructs the whole chain before anything is said about cause
workflow.artifact: incident runbook with the failure-point evidence map and the reconstruction template
workflow.gate: every failure point names its evidence source and its retrieval deadline against the centre's retention window

workflow.action: Write the exit path and prove its symmetry
workflow.description: Document who may cancel, through which channels, the effective date and final bill rule, the payment-authorisation stop, the return method and the written confirmation
workflow.artifact: documented cancellation path with the step, channel and elapsed-time comparison against sign-up
workflow.gate: cancelling is no harder than joining on steps, channels and time, and the payment-stop step is explicit and separately verified

workflow.action: Classify endings and read the book from traced documents
workflow.description: Record an ending class on every closure and instantiate the contribution and tenure mechanism from the operator's own invoices and records
workflow.artifact: cancellation-reason mix and a contribution mechanism with each term traced to an internal document
workflow.gate: every term names its source document, no external benchmark is asserted, and tenure is presented beside the reason mix

priority_rationale: The charter, the account record and the consent and authority map come first because every routine, every family contact and every ending is measured against the promise, reads from the record and is bounded by the wearer's permissions; the monitoring routines — test cadence, supervisory health, consumables, address and contact currency, non-wear — follow because each maintains one component of the state the account health review composes; caregiver communication and the care-team interface sit on the permissions rather than on the equipment; the incident path from aftercare through reconstruction to honest disclosure depends on both the test baseline and the record, and cannot be improvised during the event; the lifecycle work of ending classification, higher-care transitions, bereavement and cancellation mechanics comes after the health work because how an account ends is only readable once what it was is recorded; and book health and the service-earned referral loop come last because they compose everything above into a truthful picture of a recurring business rather than a set of assumptions about one.

dominance_rules.rule: The wearer's own instruction dominates the payer's preference
dominance_rules.rationale: the person wearing the device is the customer even when a relative funds the account, and a business that lets the credit card decide will eventually act against the person it is meant to protect
dominance_rules.trigger: a payer instruction conflicts with the wearer's recorded preference, disclosure permission or explicit instruction
dominance_rules.action: execute the wearer's instruction, tell the payer plainly that a limit exists and who set it, and record both the request and the outcome on the account

dominance_rules.rule: Easy exit dominates protection of the recurring book
dominance_rules.rationale: the whole claim to trustworthiness with a vulnerable population collapses if leaving is engineered to be harder than joining
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal that would add a step, restrict a channel, delay an effective date or attach a condition to cancellation
dominance_rules.action: reject the proposal, run the symmetry test against the current sign-up path, and route the retention effort into service quality instead

dominance_rules.rationale: battery endurance, range, detection behaviour and response performance are properties of this account's equipment and this operator's contract, and a brochure figure repeated to a family becomes a promise
dominance_rules.trigger: anyone is about to state a reliability characteristic to a customer, a family member or a professional
dominance_rules.action: replace the assertion with this account's own test and supervisory record, or say plainly that it is not known and how it would be established

dominance_rules.rule: Bereavement handling dominates every commercial process
dominance_rules.rationale: a charge, a retention attempt or a promotion reaching a household after a death is the single most damaging thing this business can do, and no revenue justifies the risk
dominance_rules.trigger: notification, from any source, that the wearer has died
dominance_rules.action: stop billing from the notification without documents, suppress the household from all marketing and referral contact, make no save attempt, and confirm in writing

dominance_rules.rationale: the cheapest fix for false alarms removes the protection the family is paying for, and it removes it invisibly
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposal to reduce detection sensitivity, disable a feature or narrow a signalling path in order to reduce activations
dominance_rules.action: exhaust and record the physical and procedural remedies first, and make any sensitivity change the family's written decision with the trade stated

dominance_rules.rationale: a cause asserted early and retracted later destroys more trust than the original failure did
dominance_rules.trigger: a family asks what went wrong before the reconstruction has separated established from undetermined
dominance_rules.action: state what is known, what is still being checked and when the answer will come, and offer no theory of cause

dominance_rules.rule: Honest redundancy dominates retention on a higher-care move
dominance_rules.rationale: a family that discovers later they were paying for a service the residence already provided will never refer anyone, and told early they often do
dominance_rules.trigger: a wearer moves into a residence, facility or household with its own call arrangements
dominance_rules.action: state plainly where the service is likely redundant and where a genuine gap remains, before any discussion of continuation or suspension

dominance_rules.rule: Proving the chain dominates closing the job
dominance_rules.rationale: a swapped device, a replaced cell or a migrated unit is an untested unit, and paperwork completion has never summoned help
dominance_rules.trigger: any device swap, consumable replacement or migration that touched the alarm path
dominance_rules.action: require a recorded end-to-end test result before the work item is closed and the account returns to a healthy state

dominance_rules.rule: Contact and access currency dominates cosmetic equipment work
dominance_rules.rationale: responders held at a locked lobby or a tree of dead numbers defeat perfectly working equipment, and currency decays faster than hardware
dominance_rules.trigger: service capacity in a period is insufficient for the whole queue
dominance_rules.action: spend the capacity on stale address, access and contact confirmations before cosmetic or convenience equipment items

dominance_rules.rationale: the fastest route to a decision is usually the relative who answers the telephone, which is exactly how a wearer's privacy is lost
dominance_rules.trigger: staff need information or a decision and the authorised party is slower to reach than an unauthorised one
dominance_rules.action: wait for or pursue the authorised party, and record the delay as a service cost rather than solving it by disclosing to whoever answers

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the service promise and refusal boundary before writing any service script, template or briefing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: scripts and letters that promise coordination, outcomes or reliability the business must later retract in front of a family it has already frightened

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the disclosure permissions and authority lists before the first proactive family contact
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an information disclosure that cannot be undone, followed by a permission rebuild conducted during a family dispute

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm what the monitoring platform actually reports before designing the health routine around it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a monitoring routine built on event classes the contract never delivers, discovered during the first incident that needed them

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the test interval against the platform's supervision window before publishing a cadence to customers
anti_rework_rules.prevents: republishing a cadence and re-explaining it to the whole book after the first unit-missing surprise

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify contacts and access details by dialling and asking before an activation verifies them for you
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding a contact tree in the middle of the emergency it existed to serve, and the service-recovery work that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record transport and device generation on every account at installation and at every move
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an emergency book-wide audit under a carrier deadline, conducted from memory and invoices

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reconstruct the whole chain before offering the family any explanation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retracting a stated cause in front of a family, which converts a recoverable failure into a lost account and a story

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stop billing on notification of a death before asking for any document
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a refund, an apology and a reputational story that no later gesture undoes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the cost position for forced migrations once, before the first family asks
anti_rework_rules.prevents: inconsistent per-family terms that later have to be equalised across the whole affected group at the business's expense

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the ending class at the moment of closure rather than reconstructing it at period end
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a reason mix assembled from memory that misdirects the next period's effort at the wrong problem

iteration_protocol.trigger: a scheduled test fails or is missed
iteration_protocol.action: start the escalation clock, run the device, path and power checks, repair or replace, and re-test before the account may return to a healthy state

iteration_protocol.trigger: a real activation occurs on any account
iteration_protocol.action: run aftercare, restore equipment, re-test the chain, and write what the event revealed about contacts and access back into both copies of the record

iteration_protocol.trigger: a family reports that a press produced no help
iteration_protocol.action: open the reconstruction, request the monitoring centre's record inside its retention window, and withhold any statement of cause until the reconstruction closes

iteration_protocol.trigger: nuisance activations recur on an account
iteration_protocol.action: work the source analysis in order from placement and form factor to handling and briefing, and record any sensitivity trade as the family's written decision

iteration_protocol.trigger: non-wear indications appear or the household reports the device is not being worn
iteration_protocol.action: hold the wearing conversation, offer a form-factor or placement remedy, and state plainly that an unworn device is not protection and that the account may be ended

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier, equipment maker or monitoring centre announces a retirement or platform change
iteration_protocol.action: list affected accounts from the transport and generation fields, sequence the migration by exposure, and run an end-to-end test on every swapped unit

iteration_protocol.trigger: the wearer moves to a residence or facility, is admitted to hospital, or dies
iteration_protocol.action: route the ending to its matching lifecycle path, stop or suspend billing on the stated rule, and record the ending class at closure

iteration_protocol.trigger: the cancellation-reason mix or the per-account contribution shifts materially
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the mechanism from current invoices, contracts and service records and re-aim the health review's triage at the drivers it names

iteration_protocol.trigger: a referral approach draws a complaint or reaches a suppressed household
iteration_protocol.action: suspend approaches, review the suppression rules and the permitted moments, and re-brief everyone who asks for referrals
